main_text.p: Dentarpaga] Odontagra. Iun. Forficula, Plin. Forfi-ces, Celf. Forfices dentarpagæ, Var.
Dentatus] Broccus. Bronchus. & Brochus, Broncus. Brocus, Non. Dento, Mart. Rhinoceros (dente eminulo) Id. Oxyodontas, Lucil.
Dentes nudare] Riftum diducere, Hor. Restringere den-tes. Irridet me albis dentibus. Canem irritatam imitari, Plaut. Immodicus hiatus ri�único ftum distendit, Quint.
Dentes primores] Adversi dentes, Cic. Incisores, Isid. Ge-lasini, Cal. Rhod. Mordices, Plaut.
Denticulatus] Denticulata falx, Plin. Dentata cornua scarabæi bisulcis forpicibus, Id. Tribulata falcicula, Pallad.
Dentiscalpium] Cuspis frondea. Penna dentes levans, Mart. Spina argentea, Petr. Acus arundinea, Marcell.

Denunciare hostilitatem alicui] Denunciare alicui, Abs. Denunciare inimicitias, iram, dimicationem. Indicere ali-cui arma, funus, Cic. Sanguinarium nuncium alicui mitte-re, Plin. Clarigare, Id. Clarigationem exercere, Serv.
Denunciatio] Clarigatio, Quint. Inimicitiæ indictæ. Ob-nunciatio, Perduellia. Odia professa, Id.
Denuo] Iterum, Plaut. Revertor rursus denuo, Id. Rur-sus, Cic. Ab integro, Virg. De integro, Ter. Ex integro, Plin. Ab inchoato, Col.

Denuo aliquid tentare, agere, aggredi] Integrare pugnam, certamen, Virg. Retexere, Hor. Recomponere lapillos. Reconducere domum, Vlp. Recreare Consules, augu-res, Cic. Refervescit sanguis in terram fusus. Reponere dia-dema quod ille abjecerat. Recidunt in terram omnia, Id. Redordiri. Resorbere, quæ evomimus, Plin. Resumere tela, Ovid. Repolire, Col. Reddere incudi, Hor. Revende-re, Vlp. Sub incudem revocare.
Depangere] Pangere malleolos, Col. Repangere. Infere-re furculos. Ponere vites, Defigere. Deponere. Demer-gere.

page.notes: Catchword and signature "N" appear at foot centre; "gere." at lower right is the catchword-continuation word of the next line. Some small print and show-through on the right edge were not transcribed. Doubtful: "Riftum" and "hiatus riɛtum" read as "riftum"; the entry "Riɛtum" in the Dentes nudare line should be checked.
